name: Kaiser Aluminum
outlook:
What Kaiser Aluminum says to expect

  • Full year 2026: conversion revenue and Adjusted EBITDAFor the balance of 2026, the Company continues to expect Conversion Revenue growth at the high end of its 10% to 15% outlook, reflecting continued end-market strength and favorable pricing and mix. While the Company is maintaining its Adjusted EBITDA growth outlook of 45% to 55% compared to 2025, results are now expected toward the lower end of the range due to planned operational outages, execution performance, customer year-end inventory alignment and metal-related headwinds.
The company's own words, from its earnings release (Form 8-K, Exhibit 99), filed October 21, 2026. They are its expectations, not ours, and not a forecast or price target from The Filing Desk. Replaced when the next release is out.
